title: Mountain Landscape with Rainbow
credit: 1. The Yorck Project (2002) 10.000 Meisterwerke der Malerei (DVD-ROM), distributed by DIRECTMEDIA Publishing GmbH. ISBN : 3936122202 . 2. Unknown source Unknown source 3. Google Arts & Culture — KAHeCCNrV8XrgA
caption_long: A near-black Romantic mountain valley sits beneath a storm-heavy sky, crossed edge to edge by a pale luminous rainbow. A tiny seated traveler in a red coat rests on a foreground boulder, making the dark central peak and vast arc feel monumental. Dense evergreen forest, autumn trees, and mossy green ground emerge from brown-black shadow; restrained oil glazes create a hushed, uncanny calm after rain.
caption_short: a lone traveler beneath a rainbow in a dark mountain valley.

title: Cactus, plate 4521
credit: Curtis's Botanical Magazine volume 76 plate 4521. Reproduced at finerareprints.com , and Missouri Botanical Garden
caption_long: A vertical botanical plate isolates a flowering cactus against warm ivory paper. One enormous magenta-purple bloom opens toward the upper left while a closed striped bud rises at right; ribbed green stems and dense radial spines fill the lower half. A small graphite-like analytical study of the flower and round cactus body appears at lower left. Precise hand coloring, fine engraved outlines, and subtle paper aging balance scientific detail with lush color.
caption_short: a vivid purple cactus flower on an antique botanical plate.

title: Algae Britannicae, plate 9
credit: engraving
ocr_text: DICTYOTEAE. Tab. IX. A. echinatus. Asperococcus. P. plantaginea. Punctaria. S. attenuata. Striaria.
caption_long: A tall nineteenth-century scientific plate divides several British algae specimens into narrow columns: elongated olive fronds, a broad stippled blade, and delicate branching filaments. Enlarged cellular cross-sections, spores, and tissue diagrams form a measured row along the bottom. Muted sage, umber, and ink-black marks sit on foxed cream paper, with ruled borders and elegant engraved labels giving the composition the clarity of a field manual.
caption_short: antique scientific diagrams of olive-green British algae.

title: Mountain Landscape
credit: Own work by the original uploader
caption_long: A broad oil-painted valley opens from a rocky, tree-framed foreground toward layered mountain walls. A small waterfall flashes white at center and feeds a reflective pool and winding stream; late sunlight pours from the upper right, dissolving distant ridges into pearl-gray haze. Russet shrubs, dark green woods, lichen-covered rocks, and a luminous cloud break create a spacious pastoral atmosphere with crisp foreground texture and soft atmospheric depth.
caption_short: sunlit mountains, a small waterfall, and a quiet reflective valley.

title: Still Life with Fruit
credit: Wallraf-Richartz-Museum
caption_long: An extravagant vertical forest still life piles grapes, peaches, melons, corn, squash, and curling vines into a glowing pyramid against near-black woodland. Birds hover and perch around a nest of blue eggs; butterflies, beetles, a spider, lizards, and a small snake animate the shadows. Jewel-like oranges, translucent green grapes, and striped gourds catch focused highlights while the edges disappear into velvety darkness, producing abundance with a slightly uncanny wild mood.
caption_short: a dark, abundant forest still life of fruit, birds, insects, and reptiles.

title: The Rocky Mountains, Lander's Peak
credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, online
caption_long: A panoramic Rocky Mountain valley leads from a broad Indigenous encampment in the foreground to a brilliant snow-covered summit. Tipis, horses, and many small figures spread across a sunlit meadow beside a glassy river; a white waterfall drops through the middle distance. Deep green trees and warm ochre cliffs frame cool blue peaks under a clear turquoise sky, using meticulous oil detail and atmospheric haze to create immense scale.
caption_short: a vast Rocky Mountain valley with tipis, horses, waterfall, and snowy peak.

title: View of a Morning Room Interior
credit: kwFPxqkU1TNYjg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level
caption_long: A precisely rendered Regency-era morning room is viewed straight on, its paneled gray walls and wooden floor organized around a central fireplace and round breakfast table. Two seated women occupy separate pools of activity, one at a mirror and one reading or writing. Tall curtained windows admit soft lateral daylight across coral upholstery, framed pictures, glass domes, chairs, and a blue sewing basket; the watercolor-like finish feels intimate, orderly, and observational.
caption_short: a quiet old morning room with two women, breakfast table, and tall curtained windows.

title: Flower Still Life
credit: Google Arts & Culture — NwEGD5RkEhihQQ
caption_long: A woven basket overflowing with roses, tulips, iris, cyclamen, and small blue and yellow flowers sits on a stone ledge against a black ground. Loose blossoms extend across the foreground while a dragonfly, bee, beetle, and two butterflies punctuate the carefully staged arrangement. Coral, ivory, ultramarine, and lemon petals glow under crisp directional light; smooth oil technique and minute natural detail make the bouquet opulent yet delicately alive.
caption_short: an ornate flower basket with tulips, roses, butterflies, and insects on a dark background.

title: Still Life: Apples and Jar
credit: hAFv-WOJDxEgvw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level
caption_long: A compact modernist still life crowds a shallow tabletop with a pale ceramic storage jar, blue-rimmed bowl, white cup, folded cloth, and a platter of green, yellow, and orange apples. Thick, blocky oil strokes simplify every object into overlapping planes. Bright fruit and icy whites stand against a fractured near-black backdrop of burgundy, teal, ochre, and violet, creating a weighty, rhythmic composition with no soft illusionism.
caption_short: chunky painted apples, bowls, cup, and pale jar against a dark abstracted background.

title: Luncheon Still Life
credit: FQEvQGP0Y05yog at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level
caption_long: A white-clothed outdoor table is spread with a tipped wicker fruit basket, oranges, grapes, walnuts, sliced citrus, biscuits, glassware, dark bottles, and a blue-and-white relief pitcher. The arrangement runs horizontally before an open landscape at dusk, where a moody blue sky and distant hills contrast with the tabletop. Clear glass reflections, warm amber drinks, and detailed textures give the oil painting a celebratory but recently abandoned feeling.
caption_short: an outdoor luncheon table with fruit, bottles, glasses, nuts, and evening landscape.

title: Textile with Stylized Carnations
credit: Image: http://collections.lacma.org/sites/default/files/remote_images/piction/ma-31874777-O3.jpg Gallery: http://collections.lacma.org/node/239827 archive copy at the Wayback Machine
caption_long: A long, narrow textile panel repeats fan-shaped carnation blossoms and curling stems in a disciplined vertical rhythm. Flat floral silhouettes and leafy arabesques interlock across the fabric, emphasizing the relationship between positive motifs and the ground. The aged woven surface softens the limited historical palette, while small variations in contour and dye density keep the repeated ornamental design tactile rather than mechanically perfect.
caption_short: a long antique textile repeating stylized fan-shaped carnations.

title: Dalton House Kitchen, west view
credit: https://www.loc.gov/pictures/item/nv0156.photos.048931p
caption_long: A frontal black-and-white architectural survey photograph records an empty mid-century kitchen. Two rounded refrigerators stand open at center, with bare shelves and enamel interiors exposed; a long sink cabinet and small window line the right wall, and a low table clips the left edge. A dramatically patterned floral carpet spreads toward the camera. Flat flash light, white cabinetry, and dark photographic borders make the vacant room feel clinical, lonely, and time-capsuled.
caption_short: an empty old kitchen with open refrigerators and a dark floral carpet.

title: Mushrooms of America, plate XI
credit: https://www.flickr.com/photos/biodivlibrary/8597825250
ocr_text: PLATE XI. POISONOUS OR SUSPICIOUS BOLETI.
caption_long: A cream natural-history plate presents four large boletes as a clustered specimen group, dominated by deep crimson and rust caps, sturdy red-brown stems, and one cut section showing pale flesh. Small numerals tie each mushroom to dense explanatory text below. Saturated chromolithographic reds rise from a mossy green base, while the bold uppercase heading and scientific labels make the image both cautionary diagram and theatrical portrait.
caption_short: four red and brown poisonous mushrooms on an antique identification plate.

title: Male Shield Fern, botanical atlas plate XXII
credit: https://www.flickr.com/photos/biodivlibrary/7351351268
ocr_text: CRYPTOGAMS. MALE SHIELD FERN. PLATE XXII.
caption_long: A vertical botanical atlas plate centers one fully spread male shield fern, each dark green pinna rendered with fine serrated detail. Smaller studies surround it: upper and lower leaf surfaces, a rooted underground stem, coiled young fronds, spores, and a magnified tissue cross-section. Fine captions and figure numbers sit inside a thin ruled border on ivory paper; olive, brown, and black hand coloring keeps the scientific layout calm and exact.
caption_short: a detailed antique fern plate with roots, spores, and magnified leaf anatomy.

title: Ever-blowing China Rose
credit: https://digitalcollections.nypl.org/items/510d47dc-9363-a3d9-e040-e00a18064a99
ocr_text: T. 7. No 9. ROSA semper florens. ROSIER de tous les mois.
caption_long: A single pink China rose branch floats against the pale page of an open botanical book. The layered central blossom faces forward, surrounded by five closed buds, thorny stems, and deeply veined blue-green leaves. Delicate engraved contours and transparent hand coloring preserve every prickle and fold, with generous blank space and a faint blue wash behind the flower. Latin and French names anchor the specimen along the bottom margin.
caption_short: a pink China rose with buds and thorny blue-green leaves on an antique page.

title: Risch Kitchen Police Photograph
credit: The Search for Joan Risch , p. 16
caption_long: A stark black-and-white police photograph looks down across a linoleum kitchen floor toward pale cabinets and a rounded enamel stove. An unspooled roll of paper, scattered pages, a wastebasket, and a large dark smeared stain disrupt the domestic order. Hard flash flattens the cabinets and sharpens every handle, tile, and trace on the floor, producing an evidentiary, unsettling mood rather than a composed home interior.
caption_short: a stark vintage police photograph of a disordered kitchen floor.

title: Still Life with Lobster and Fruit
credit: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art . See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy
caption_long: A sumptuous Dutch-style banquet still life emerges from a nearly black room: a scarlet lobster stretches across the left foreground beside peeled lemon, tipped silver vessels, peaches, grapes, melon, glassware, and a towering amber ornamental vessel. Objects cascade over a dark brown cloth, catching narrow glints of light. Deep umber glazing, metallic reflections, translucent fruit, and the lobster’s saturated shell create dense, shadowy luxury.
caption_short: a shadowy banquet still life with red lobster, silverware, grapes, and amber glass.

title: Textile Design for Le Dieu Bleu
credit: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art . See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy
caption_long: A square costume-textile study is centered on a hand-painted geometric medallion. Mirrored pink leaf forms and circular targets lock into four black-and-gold diamonds with small starbursts, while graphite construction lines and unfinished satellite shapes remain visible around the motif. Gouache, pencil, stains, and worn cream paper expose the design process; dusty magenta, silver gray, ochre, and black feel theatrical, handmade, and slightly weathered.
caption_short: a worn geometric textile sketch in dusty pink, black, silver, and gold.

title: Standing Male Figure: Study for a Portrait
credit: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art . See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy
caption_long: A quickly drawn standing man fills a narrow sheet, leaning with one arm against an architectural ledge while the other hand holds a broad hat. Loose brown ink lines describe a buttoned period coat, breeches, stockings, and a casual crossed-leg stance; darker hatching gathers along his right side. Pentimenti, stains, and faint background marks remain visible on warm aged paper, preserving the lively searching quality of a preparatory sketch.
caption_short: a loose brown-ink study of a standing man in period dress holding a hat.

title: Study for Portraits
credit: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art . See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy
caption_long: A softly washed family portrait study groups a seated woman and several children in a compressed domestic scene. Red chalk establishes faces, drapery, and a sweeping curtain; diluted gray-black wash deepens the woman’s bodice, chair, and lower shadows. Figures overlap and dissolve at the edges, with visible revisions and rubbed passages on blue-gray paper. The unfinished handling feels tender, informal, and more concerned with gesture than polished likeness.
caption_short: a tender unfinished red-chalk and wash study of a mother with children.

title: Study for the Portrait of Louis-François Bertin
credit: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art . See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy
caption_long: A seated middle-aged man faces the viewer directly, leaning forward with both broad hands planted on his knees. Fine graphite builds his intense eyes, tousled hair, heavy coat, waistcoat, and compressed pose; the surrounding chair and partial figure at right remain lightly indicated. The pale joined paper and restrained gray line emphasize psychological concentration over setting, giving the preparatory portrait a forceful, unsentimental presence.
caption_short: an intense graphite portrait study of a seated man leaning forward.

title: Half-Length Portrait Study of a Wigged Man
credit: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art . See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy
caption_long: A half-length eighteenth-century gentleman stands in a formal three-quarter pose, one hand set at his waist and the other holding a draped hat. Pale chalk and graphite model his curled wig, long coat, waistcoat, and composed face against blue prepared paper. A faint square transfer grid covers the sheet, revealing the study’s working purpose; narrow tonal range and careful contour create restrained elegance.
caption_short: a gridded chalk portrait of a wigged gentleman in formal eighteenth-century dress.

title: Telephone Sign Outside a Restaurant and Café
credit: Missouri History Museum URL: http://images.mohistory.org/image/4A680A26-7BA0-6EDA-2DF0-D7FF15D62670/original.jpg Gallery: http://collections.mohistory.org/resource/151482
caption_long: A black-and-white street photograph peers into a restaurant window layered with reflections. A square bell-shaped sign reading “LOCAL / LONG / DISTANCE / TELEPHONE” hangs near the upper left and repeats backward in the glass; fragments of a large “CAFE” sign, lamps, buildings, and a blurred passerby overlap below. Deep blacks, silver glare, ornate window trim, and doubled lettering turn an ordinary storefront into a dense urban collage.
caption_short: reflected café window with a vintage long-distance telephone sign and layered street lettering.

title: Decorators Wallpaper Company Sign
credit: Decorators Wallpaper Company Sign, West End, Cincinnati, OH
caption_long: A contemporary color photograph looks up at a weathered brick industrial building beneath a saturated blue sky. A long, ghosted painted advertisement reading “DECORATORS WALLPAPER” fades across the pale cornice; utility poles and many black wires slice diagonally over the façade. Boarded and mismatched windows, graffiti murals, orange brick, and the nearly erased commercial lettering create a layered record of reuse and urban time.
caption_short: a faded wallpaper company sign above brick, murals, utility poles, and blue sky.

title: Textile Design with Alternating Triangles
credit: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art . See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy
caption_long: A rectangular textile swatch repeats alternating upright and inverted triangles in oxblood red and warm taupe. Stippled fields and small black rings with white pearl-like centers create rows of eye-shaped accents, while crisp diagonal seams make a strong tessellated grid. The inked or painted sample sits unevenly on white mount paper, retaining frayed edges and handmade variation within the severe geometric repeat.
caption_short: an oxblood and taupe triangle textile pattern dotted with pearl-like circles.

title: Paisley Textile Design
credit: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art . See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy
caption_long: An irregular oval textile design fills the page with oversized paisley teardrops and softly modeled circular cells. Burgundy and dusty rose stippling creates a dense honeycomb ground; cream branching garlands, tiny four-dot flowers, and accents of mustard yellow, violet, and black travel across it. Cropped motifs imply a seamless repeat, while the cut paper edges and visible surface wear retain the tactile character of a working pattern sample.
caption_short: a burgundy paisley and honeycomb textile pattern with tiny flowers and mustard accents.

title: Carlton Kitchen Interior with Woman and Three Children
credit: http://search.slv.vic.gov.au/permalink/f/1cl35st/SLV_VOYAGER1777164
caption_long: A grainy black-and-white documentary photograph gathers a woman and three children around a rough kitchen table and broad brick hearth. One child leans at left, another sits on the fireplace ledge, and the woman holds a baby at right; cups, tins, pans, laundry, and worn walls crowd the shallow room. Soft available light and candid expressions convey domestic closeness, fatigue, and resilience without romantic polish.
caption_short: a candid old kitchen scene with a mother, three children, brick hearth, and worn table.

title: Pacific Net and Twine Company Storefront at Pier 6
credit: Museum of History and Industry
ocr_text: MILWAUKEE PIER NO. 6. PACIFIC NET & TWINE CO. NEW ENGLAND FISH CO. SHIP CHANDLERY. FISHERY & CANNERY SUPPLIES. ROPE CORDAGE.
caption_long: A framed black-and-white photograph records a long wooden waterfront storefront covered in bold hand-painted signs. Horse-drawn wagons and an early motorcar line the dirt street beneath advertisements for “PACIFIC NET & TWINE CO.,” “PIER NO. 6,” ship chandlery, rope, cordage, and fish supplies. Strong block lettering dominates the façade, while people, wheels, harnesses, and utility wires provide crisp documentary detail.
caption_short: an early waterfront storefront covered in bold signs, with wagons, horses, and a motorcar.

title: Kitchen Interior
credit: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
caption_long: A nearly empty rustic kitchen is painted in deep brown shadow, with a plain wooden table centered beneath two small green-framed windows. An open doorway at left reveals a narrow strip of bright grass and cool outdoor light; a cupboard, buckets, stove recess, and simple stool recede into darkness. Thin daylight edges the floor and furniture, creating a solitary dusk-like stillness in muted umber, moss green, and smoky black.
caption_short: a lonely dim wooden kitchen with an open door, small windows, and a bare table.

title: Music Room Interior in Peremyl
credit: National Museum in Warsaw
caption_long: A painted music-room interior organizes upholstered seating, instruments, and dark furniture within a lived-in salon. Vertical architectural lines and the measured placement of domestic objects lead toward the back wall, while subdued daylight settles across polished surfaces and textiles. Muted earth colors, gray-green shadow, and restrained brushwork give the room a quiet, private atmosphere, suggesting music paused rather than a staged decorative display.
caption_short: a quiet muted music room with instruments, upholstered furniture, and soft daylight.

title: Room Interior
credit: National Museum in Warsaw
caption_long: An austere room is submerged in brown-black shadow. A low wooden table or chest occupies the foreground, while a pale plaster partition catches the only broad plane of light; above it, a tiny window, bottle, and simple vessel barely emerge. Thin vertical supports and a reddish plank floor dissolve toward the edges. The sparse oil painting feels silent, enclosed, and dusk-dark, built from umber glazes rather than descriptive detail.
caption_short: a sparse shadowy room with a low table, tiny window, and pale plaster wall.

title: The National Gallery, Interior of Room 32
credit: nationalgallery.org.uk
caption_long: A bustling Victorian gallery interior stretches beneath a luminous coffered glass ceiling and rows of arched wall panels. Dozens of visitors in black dresses, hats, and tailored coats sit, stand, and converse among densely hung paintings and freestanding screens. Warm amber light washes red-brown walls, wood floors, gilt frames, and marble columns; the wide composition balances social observation with grand museum architecture.
caption_short: a crowded Victorian museum gallery under a glowing glass ceiling.

title: Dining Room
credit: Own work
caption_long: A childlike modern dining room is painted with thick, ridged impasto and deliberately flattened perspective. A red-and-white checked tablecloth dominates the left foreground; green chairs flank a white fireplace, a black cat curls on the floor, and a red-haired doll sits beside a slipcovered sofa. Chalky gray walls, small framed pictures, white flowers, and bright vermilion accents make the domestic scene playful, awkward, and tactile.
caption_short: a thickly painted gray dining room with checked tablecloth, green chairs, black cat, and red doll.

title: Mountain Landscape at Twilight
credit: https://joslyn.org/art/collection/gustave-dor/mountain-landscape
caption_long: A long horizontal mountain panorama settles into twilight. Dark blue ridges form layered silhouettes beneath a peach-to-slate sky pricked with tiny stars; a narrow lake or river catches an electric turquoise band across the middle distance. Scrubby brown foreground fields and a minute cabin cluster emphasize remoteness. Smooth tonal transitions and restrained details create a cool, spacious stillness between sunset and night.
caption_short: dark mountain silhouettes, turquoise water, and first stars at twilight.
